C0567.title: 17-Year-Old Sentenced to 6 Years for ¥4 Million Fake Return Scam
C0567.summary: In January 2026, a 17-year-old was sentenced to 6 years in prison for defrauding e-commerce platforms of ¥4 million through a fake return scheme.

references.title: 17-Year-Old Teen Falsely Returned Items to 'Coupon' 4 Million Yuan, Sentenced to 6 Years
